持续探索通信、AI 与智能硬件。本网站记录我的科研论文、竞赛项目与个人作品，研究: I continue to explore communications, AI, and intelligent hardware. This website documents my research papers, competition projects, and personal work. My research interests include trustworthy AI question answering, clustered metasurfaces, intelligent information systems, and embedded development.
